basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee. No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview, including for SC/ST candidates.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | research assistant: Graduate in Social Work/Sociology/Psychology/Public Health from a recognized university with two years' work experience in relevant field. OR Postgraduate (Master's) degree in the above relevant subjects.

salary_details.details: The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits and is based on experience, qualifications, and skill set of the candidates.

selection_process: The selection process involves a Screening/Scrutiny Test (depending on the number of applicants) conducted by the Competent Authority
followed by a Walk-In-Interview for eligible candidates.
how_to_apply: Download the official notification and application format from the AIIMS Jodhpur website.
Fill out the application in the prescribed format and prepare your bio-data.
Gather all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience.
Attach all essential qualifications and experience certificates with the application form.

Attend the Walk-In-Interview in person on 16/10/2026 at 09:30 AM at the Skill and Innovation Centre, First Floor, Behind the College of Nursing, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Basni, Phase-II, Jodhpur - 342005.
important_instructions: The posts are filled purely on a temporary basis, co-terminus with the project, and candidates have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur. Reporting time for candidates starts at 09:30 AM on 16/10/2026, and reporting for interview closes at 10:00 AM on the same day. No additional candidates will be entertained after this time. Persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertakings must produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the time of interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Incomplete applications lacking essential qualifications and experience certificates will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Important Dates
AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice offers 2 vacancies for the Research Assistant post under the extramural research project titled "NIHR Global Health Research Centre for Multiple Long-Term Conditions".

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: Graduate in Social Work/Sociology/Psychology/Public Health from a recognized university with two years' work experience in relevant field. OR Postgraduate (Master's) degree in the above relevant subjects.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Salary
content_sections.text: The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits and is based on experience, qualifications, and skill set of the candidates.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee. No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview, including for SC/ST candidates.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process involves a Screening/Scrutiny Test (depending on the number of applicants) conducted by the Competent Authority, followed by a Walk-In-Interview for eligible candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and application format from the AIIMS Jodhpur website. Fill out the application in the prescribed format and prepare your bio-data. Gather all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience. Attach all essential qualifications and experience certificates with the application form. Attend the Walk-In-Interview in person on 16/10/2026 at 09:30 AM at the Skill and Innovation Centre, First Floor, Behind the College of Nursing, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Basni, Phase-II, Jodhpur - 342005.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Filled application in the prescribed format Bio-data Original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies of age proof Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Relevant experience certificates No Objection Certificate (NOC) if working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The posts are filled purely on a temporary basis, co-terminus with the project, and candidates have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur. Reporting time for candidates starts at 09:30 AM on 16/10/2026, and reporting for interview closes at 10:00 AM on the same day. No additional candidates will be entertained after this time. Persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertakings must produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the time of interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Incomplete applications lacking essential qualifications and experience certificates will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jodhpur has advertised for 2 Research Assistant posts under the extramural research project titled "NIHR Global Health Research Centre for Multiple Long-Term Conditions" in the Department of Paediatrics.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Research Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 16 October 2026, with candidate reporting starting at 09:30 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate in Social Work/Sociology/Psychology/Public Health with two years of relevant experience, OR a Postgraduate (Master's) degree in the relevant subjects.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Research Assistant post is 35 years.
